en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2566 - In a narration from Aban, from Ali ibn Abdul Aziz, he said:

"Abu Abdullah (as) performed ghusl at Dhu al-Hulayfah for Ihram, prayed, and then said: 'Bring me what you have from the meat of game.'
Two partridges were brought to him, and he ate them before entering the state of Ihram."
